# Tablist

> Import your BoardGameGeek collection, filter what fits tonight's table, and keep a lasting record of every game night.

Tablist (https://tablist.app) is a free web app for tabletop hosts. It helps you manage a personal board game collection, filter and randomly pick games for the current group, log sessions and scores, and optionally connect with friends. Game catalog metadata comes from BoardGameGeek. Sign-in (email/password or Google) is required for the app itself; the pages linked below are public.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tablist.app/): Product overview — shelf search, sessions, friends, and how it works
- [Privacy Policy](https://tablist.app/privacy): How Tablist collects, uses, and protects personal data
- [Terms of Service](https://tablist.app/terms): Terms that govern use of Tablist
